fault_application: once at the frozen orbital-coast origin before deorbit; persistent; both arms receive identical faulted state and engine capability
candidate_contract: shared trimmed_state_terminal_v4 phase/controller; map physical healthy landing engines to active slots; reflect actual thrust in terminal budget; rescale requested deorbit/flip total thrust and surviving-engine count within existing min/max throttle, gimbal, slew and RCS constraints; no change to pose, mass, inertia, aerodynamics, return time or contact limits
order: nominal original_plan first, then registered fault order, original_plan before available_capacity_return_v1; no retry, no result-dependent tuning
a_definition: valid six-DOF terminal record; original-plan contact fails any unchanged contact limit, OR passes but loses >=10000 kg reserve or lands >=120 s later than the nominal original-plan control
b_definition: candidate has a valid six-DOF contact record meeting all four unchanged contact limits
condition_selection: first registered fault with a AND b, only after completing the frozen screen; freeze fault/origin/controller/source/record hashes before any future AI trial
stop_rules: nominal control fails or is invalid
numerical failure or exception retained and cannot count as physical failure
after all registered rows or first execution-budget abort; no additional conditions
after stage-1 report, stop before stage 2
interpretation: candidate-generation engineering screen, not held-out AI performance, a Rules-score contest, physical landing, water survival or completion of stages 2-4

retention.records: write each complete/partial rollout as gzip JSON and SHA256; never overwrite; copy frozen sources, input/registration and budget/verification ledgers
retention.cleanup: no Docker or unrelated deletion; keep unique compressed records and source snapshot
